fit_reason: Whole 14 ft Lund aluminum fishing boat with outboards, listed by owner in boats by owner.
findings: Flat, dull finish on the camo-painted aluminum hull sides, with light dirt and scuffing near the stern
Dusty, scuffed camo paint on the outboard cowling
Loose gear, bags and clutter piled inside the boat around the seats
Dirt and debris on the floor and interior paint near the bow and middle bench
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 14 ft Lund. The camo paint on the hull and motor cover looks a bit dusty and flat, and clearing out the gear and cleaning the inside would help it show better in photos. We do pre-sale details for boats and come to you. Would you like a quote?
